title: Pan-Seared Halal Chicken with Date Compote
description: A sweet and savory Italian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared halal chicken served with a rich date compote.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, combine dates, balsamic vinegar, and sugar-free chocolate chips in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the dates are caramelized and the sauce is thickened.
To serve, slice the chicken breast and top with the date compote.
